title: rosa canina var. permiscibilis
intro: Rosa canina var. permiscibilis, commonly known as Wild Rose or Dog Rose, is a variety of the Rosa canina species, known for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Rosa canina var. permiscibilis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-aging, wound healing, and gastrointestinal protection. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe and calm the body, promoting overall well-being.
